title: GST rate cuts slow down Q1 tax collection growth
summary: The Centre's fiscal deficit reached 18% of its annual estimate during the first quarter. Tax revenue saw a modest increase, while capital expenditure rose significantly. Revenue expenditure also experienced a notable rise, driven by subsidies. Increased fertilizer and fuel subsidies were cited as contributing factors.
summary_points: GST rate cuts led to slower Q1 tax collection growth
Fiscal deficit reached 18% of annual estimate in first quarter
Revenue expenditure increased due to subsidies
